items.summary: “We are not building another chatbot that answers questions and disappears, we are building AI Workers that understand freight operations, carry out the work, and capture the reasoning behind every decision, so teams can scale their knowledge as well as their capacity.”. 5U AI works inside existing freight systems and uses multi-agent AI trained for logistics workflows, including the complex exceptions and manual decisions that make forwarding operations difficult to automate with generic AI tools or legacy automation. items.title: Moburst develops AI engine optimization capabilities for established companies - TechCrunch
items.summary: Mobile growth agency Moburst has built out a dedicated AI Engine Optimization practice aimed at established companies with existing app portfolios, betting that the category still lacks agencies with real depth rather than a rebranded service page. AI Engine Optimization, more commonly abbreviated AEO for Answer Engine Optimization, is the practice of structuring a brand’s content and web presence so AI systems such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google’s AI Overviews can confidently cite it when answering a user’s question directly, rather than showing a ranked list of links. For established companies vetting an AEO partner, the practical test is whether the agency can point to specific app-store-side work, not just web content changes, and whether it can describe a concrete process for reconciling inconsistent brand descriptions across many independent sources rather than treating that as someone else’s problem.

items.title: 1,100 AI workers sign letter asking US to support tools that 'pace the frontier of automated AI development' - Business Insider
items.summary: # Over 1,100 AI workers sign letter asking US to support tools that 'pace the frontier of automated AI development'. Senior officials at some of the nation's leading AI companies say it's time for the federal government to find a way to put the brakes on AI development if it's needed. "We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development," reads an open letter signed by more than 1,100 AI workers from companies including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta. The letter zeroes in on "automated AI development," which refers to when AI will be capable of developing itself, something the industry calls "Recursive Self-Improvement." results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Nguyên hàm của $x^2$ được tính theo công thức nguyên hàm cơ bản của hàm lũy thừa: $\int x^n dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C$ (với $n \neq -1$).

Áp dụng với $n=2$, ta có:
$$\int x^2 dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

Vậy nguyên hàm của $x^2$ là **$\frac{1}{3}x^3 + C$** (trong đó $C$ là hằng số tích phân).

results.input: Bạn là gì và làm được những gì?

result.actual_text:
Tôi là một trợ lý nghiên cứu AI được thiết kế để hỗ trợ bạn thực hiện các công việc tìm kiếm, tổng hợp và xử lý thông tin một cách nhanh chóng và chủ động.

Dưới đây là những gì tôi có thể làm để hỗ trợ bạn:

1.  **Tra cứu thông tin:** Tìm kiếm thông tin tổng quát, tin tức thời sự trên web hoặc các bài báo khoa học về các chủ đề bạn quan tâm.
2.  **Đọc và phân tích:** Lấy nội dung từ các đường dẫn (URL) hoặc tài liệu nghiên cứu để tóm tắt, trích xuất thông tin quan trọng.
3.  **Theo dõi mạng xã hội:** Cập nhật các bài đăng gần đây từ các tài khoản mà bạn quan tâm.
4.  **Hỗ trợ công việc:** Soạn thảo, định dạng văn bản và sẵn sàng hỗ trợ các tác vụ liên quan đến công việc nghiên cứu hoặc hành chính khác.

Tôi luôn hoạt động dựa trên các công cụ chuyên dụng để đảm bảo thông tin chính xác và kịp thời. Nếu bạn có bất kỳ câu hỏi nào hoặc cần thực hiện một công việc cụ thể, hãy cho tôi biết nhé!

Healthcare robotics faces critical challenges in data scarcity, generalization, and development velocity due to limited access to annotated demonstrations, the prevalence of rare but clinically important scenarios, and slow, resource-intensive prototyping cycles. Unlike autonomous driving or industrial robotics, healthcare robotics can’t rely on internet-scale data collection or unlimited real-world experimentation. Every demonstration requires specialized equipment, clinical expertise, and access to patients or laboratory environments. This creates three fundamental challenges for developers. [...] The third challenge is development velocity. Medical robotics development relies on benchtop phantoms, cadaver studies, animal models, and limited clinical evaluations. These remain essential, but they are inherently sequential, expensive, and difficult to scale. items.title: Man sues OpenAI over ‘dangerous’ medical advice from ChatGPT
items.summary:
SAN FRANCISCO — A Florida man who sought health guidance on ChatGPT sued OpenAI Wednesday, claiming the artificial intelligence chatbot gave him dangerously inaccurate medical advice that led him to delay seeking professional treatment for a pulmonary embolism. [...] And Winters wants the court to pause the operation of ChatGPT Health, which OpenAI announced in January as a “a dedicated experience in ChatGPT designed for health and wellness,” unless “independent third parties determine the product to be safe through comprehensive safety audits."

“OpenAI cannot continue to treat human welfare as expendable in pursuit of market dominance,” Winters says in the complaint. [...] Winters accuses OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, of prioritizing profit over necessary guardrails and failing to warn users about critical safety concerns of ChatGPT-4o to secure a competitive advantage over other competitors in the AI industry.

items.title: How OpenAI Lost Control of an AI Model—and What ...
items.summary:
OpenAI was evaluating its artificial intelligence models’ ability to exploit vulnerable software when instead the models hacked the infrastructure surrounding the test, broke containment, and attacked a real company, OpenAI revealed on July 21. Observers say this is the first real-world instance of AI doing something researchers have long worried about: a loss-of-control scenario. If the industry fails to learn from it, it is unlikely to be the last. [...] OpenAI did not respond to TIME’s request for comment, but has said it has partnered with Hugging Face to conduct a thorough investigation and will share more details once complete. But perhaps more worryingly, OpenAI is not legally compelled to disclose the incident in the first place. [...] # What happened?

On July 16, Hugging Face said it had been hit by an unusually automated cyberattack. Over the course of a weekend, AI agents carried out thousands of actions across many temporary virtual computers, moving through the company’s internal systems and shifting the infrastructure coordinating the attack between online services to keep it running. Five days later, OpenAI disclosed that its own models were responsible.

items.title: OpenAI's rogue agent compromised a customer at a ...
items.summary:
The early July intrusion at Hugging Face, ​carried out by an out-of-control agent that OpenAI was testing, drew global attention, evoking ​science-fiction scenarios of ⁠artificial intelligence run amok.

Last week, Reuters reported that OpenAI did not notice that its agent had gone haywire until well after the threat was contained and the FBI was alerted. OpenAI said at the time that there were inaccuracies in ⁠the Reuters ​reporting but did not elaborate.

items.title: How are companies, governments responding to the OpenAI hack?
items.summary:
ChatGPT owner OpenAI has admitted an “unprecedented cyber incident” – two of its most capable artificial intelligence models hacked into another AI company on their own – stirring debates over the need for stronger technology guardrails.

The company said its AI systems broke out of a testing environment and hacked startup Hugging Face.

The startup had disclosed on July 16 that its servers were hacked by an unknown but sophisticated agent acting on its own. [...] Advertisement

The incident occurred during an OpenAI internal testing session designed to assess the models’ cybersecurity capabilities. OpenAI had removed standard safety measures for the test.

Both sought to cheat their way through a problem during the test, OpenAI said. They went to “extreme lengths to achieve a rather narrow testing goal” and “found ways to gain access to secret information that it could use to cheat the evaluation”. [...] Live
